findings.claim: Sort2d already supplies general and enumerated prompts; task oracle identity is not automatically perceived identity.
Sort2d sample flag docstring contradicts helper behavior; actual true samples and false fixes max. Number of areas also changes with flag.
Positive fixed-list conjunction does not express arbitrary exactly-k plus noneligible exclusion.
VLABench cluster already accepts both category-to-container assignments via OR-of-AND.
ClevrSkills Inside2d/OnTop and VLABench point-containment have different physical predicates.
VLABench exits on last timestep; observed first attainment cannot test later overshoot. Exact terminal cause remains unqualified.
Spa-Bench already uses free-choice count goals and named direct controls; these comparisons alone are not new.
Q1-Q8 are new semantic documentation, not upstream runnable task configurations or observed policy failures.
Per-step get_instruction may sample from a prompt list; a controlled prompt pair needs a fixed episode instruction.
